tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and inbox background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the thread pane, the Decision card.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Section headers, code blocks, the composer well.

tokens.name: surface-select
tokens.usage: The selected row. Never a state colour.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and control outlines (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, row summaries, timestamps. 4.5:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Icons and dividers only, never body text (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and the brand slab. Text on it uses on-night.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and icons on night.

tokens.name: beam
tokens.usage: THE accent: the lamp. Fills only things that need the user (asking, the attention count). Never decorative.

tokens.name: beam-mark
tokens.usage: The asking icon fill. 4:1 on surface-raised in light, 9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: beam-ink
tokens.usage: Beam as text or icon on surface (asking reason, attention counts). 5:1 light, 10:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-beam
tokens.usage: Text on a beam fill.

tokens.name: beam-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the Decision card header and a focused asking row.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Failed state fill (small marks only).

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Failed state text and icon on surface. 6:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: harbour
tokens.usage: Review state, links and the focus ring. 4.9:1 light, 7.4:1 dark on surface.

tokens.name: harbour-wash
tokens.usage: Review highlight, link hover ground.

tokens.name: calm
tokens.usage: Settled state and passing checks. Used with a check icon, never by hue alone.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Thread and pane titles. One per view.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The agent merged the fix and CI is green.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Row summaries, reasons, timestamps, section counts.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, paths, hashes, PR numbers, host names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; between row meta items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding, card padding, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between card sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page regions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, kbd keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the palette, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Palette, menus and toasts only. Rows and cards have no shadow.
